answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fake identities. A new agent posts a 100 POA bond decaying 5% each epoch unless it does verified work: each honest job adds a verified edge, so a real agent grows outward from its starting vertex while an idle fake's bond spirals down to zero. The marketplace is a wharf where every agent must dock, show its bond, and take real jobs to keep its berth. Cost math: 1,000 fakes need 100,000 POA bonded and lose 5,000 POA per epoch, with no bulk discount. An honest agent pays only one bond and earns decay back through work.
